column3: With respect to the Columbus Park Crossing Mortgage Loan (7.8%), the prior loan secured by the Mortgaged Property was involved in a loan modification in November 2020 whereby the lender consented to borrower’s request to fund loan payments for the months of September through December 2020 from cash collateral reserve funds and further agreed to waive any then-outstanding late fees and penalties. The borrower subsequently replenished the amounts withdrawn from the cash collateral reserve in connection with the side letter. In addition, affiliates of the guarantor (AVR Enterprises, LLC) were involved in a mortgage default related to a retail property in Carle Place, NY that resulted in an assignment of ground lease in lieu of foreclosure. The property was adversely impacted by the anchor tenant’s (A&P’s) lease termination in 2015 and subsequent rejection of the lease in bankruptcy.
